project.name: Newport Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 11 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 4 of 119 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Newport qualifies as a local detour through Butter Cross or Pulestone Cross, on the south west side of the market place and Church of St Nicholas of Myra. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Newport: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Newport offers Butter Cross or Pulestone Cross, on the south west side of the market place, Church of St Nicholas of Myra, BUTTER CROSS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Butter Cross or Pulestone Cross, on the south west side of the market place
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Butter Cross or Pulestone Cross, on the south west side of the market place and Church of St Nicholas of Myra, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: Butter Cross or Pulestone Cross, on the south west side of the market place
